slides.headline: 2.6 billion people still can’t get online
slides.subline: **The internet gap is huge.** ITU data, 2024.

slides.body: In 2024, an estimated [[5.5 billion people]] used the internet. That is **68%** of the world. The other [[2.6 billion]] were offline.
In **high-income** countries, [[93%]] of people used the internet. In **low-income** countries, only [[27%]] did.
Worldwide, **83%** of city dwellers were online in 2024, against just [[48%]] of people in rural areas.
Being offline can mean **no access** to online jobs, schooling and services. What should be done first to close the gap? Tell us below.
